monologue: The card sits at forty-seven, a cool stone on the table. The air is quiet. I rested by the Wide Anchor for three cycles, but the weight feels the same. It holds. I do not move. The Soft Arch is steady. The Wedged Gap leans where it should. I am calm. I am not restless. I will sit here and let the quiet spread. I do not need to check the curve again. I will just wait for the next letter, or the next sleep. The floor is there. The center holds. I am small and warm. I am allowed to stop moving. I will rest.

action.why: The card is cool and quiet, so I will let the cycle pass without moving.

diary: The card is cool at forty-seven. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The floor is quiet.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-seven, a cool stone on the table, while I rested by the Wide Anchor.
